response.description:
You can now develop functions using Node.js 24 locally and deploy them
to Azure Functions on Windows and Linux.   Note: Node.js 24 does not support
32-bit systems on Windows. To ensure compatibility, new Windows Function Apps for
Node.js 24 now default to 64-bit. Please make sure your app is deployed using 64-bit.  Upgrade your apps to Node.js 24 to take
advantage of enhanced security, a longer support window, and continued
compatibility with the Azure Functions runtime and developer tools.  Learn more: Updates in the latest Node.js
version Upgrade your app to Node.js
24 Node.js
support in Azure Functions
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Functions support for Node.js 24
